one_liner: Help Scout has a broad OAuth2 REST Mailbox API and an official MCP server, but API access requires a paid plan (Standard+), since the Free plan excludes it.
auth_notes: Mailbox API 2.0 uses OAuth2 authorization code and client credentials. Apps are created self-serve under Your Profile > My apps. There is no static API key. Tokens last 48 hours. The legacy Docs API v1 uses an API key via Basic auth, but that is secondary.
access_notes: The Free plan excludes API access. The Standard plan ($25 per user per month) or higher is required. The evidence does not mention a free trial.
blocker_notes: The builder needs a paid Help Scout plan (Standard or above) to get API credentials. Reporting endpoints need Plus or Pro.

evidence.quote: The Authorization Code flow is typically used for integrations to be used by other Help Scout users.
Create one by navigating to Your Profile > My apps and click Create My App.
The Free plan does not include access to the API or integrations.
The primary REST API for managing Help Scout conversations, customers, and support operations.
Set the remote MCP server URL to `https://mcp.helpscout.net/mcp`
